description: Full public record by id (or page url): all public fields (biography, exhibitions, bibliography, technique, annotations …), every linked record grouped by type (id, type, name, years), and the other language versions. Long texts are cut at 5000 chars unless full=true; images only as image_count unless images=true. For a contributor: annotations_written (every annotation they wrote, with the record, date and text).
name: artlist-get
title: Get one Artlist record
